children: Accenture said its 2024 acquisition of Faculty is central to its new embedded evaluator partnership with Anthropic. Faculty specializes in testing and evaluating models for AI labs and has built AI systems across government, defense, and healthcare sectors. Dr. Marc Warner, Accenture's chief technology officer and Faculty's CEO, said Faculty was founded on the belief that AI should be "safe by design, not safe by accident." He added that as part of Accenture, Faculty now has the platform to do model evaluation work at a scale that can move the industry.
